headline: The call is the start. Talkera Desk keeps everyone updated until the job is done.
subhead: Real-time automated communication across both sides of the job. Your homeowners get calm certainty; your field technicians get clear dispatched notes.

callerMessage.text: Hi John, your emergency extraction is confirmed for tomorrow morning 8:30 AM at 42 Oak St. Tech Mike has been assigned. Reply HELP if you need assistance.

teamMessage.text: [NEW JOB DISPATCH] John - 42 Oak St. Water pipe burst in upper bath; shut-off turned. Time: 8:30 AM tomorrow. Status: Hold urgent extraction slot.

callerMessage.text: Good morning John! Tech Mike is scheduled to arrive between 8:30 and 9:00 AM. Are you still good for this window? Reply YES or RESCHEDULE.

teamMessage.text: [PRE-CHECK VERIFIED] John at 42 Oak St replied 'YES'. Route cleared for 8:30 AM arrival.

callerMessage.text: Got it John. We have rescheduled your inspection to 11:30 AM today. Tech Mike has been updated with the change.

teamMessage.text: [SCHEDULE UPDATED] 42 Oak St moved from 8:30 AM to 11:30 AM per homeowner SMS request. Calendar slot updated automatically.

callerMessage.text: [URGENT] We have received your emergency water damage report. Our on-call crew leader Mike has been alerted. Please ensure main water remains shut off.

teamMessage.text: [PRIORITY 1 CALL] Active ceiling leak at 42 Oak St. Caller: John. Main shut off. Emergency extraction needed. Calling your phone now.

callerMessage.text: Thank you for trusting Apex Restoration today! Tech Mike has completed the extraction work. How did we do? Reply with a rating from 1 to 5 stars.

teamMessage.text: [5-STAR REVIEW RECEIVED] John rated job #4288 5/5 stars: 'Mike was prompt, professional, and saved our flooring!' Added to CRM summary.

callerMessage.text: (End of job lifecycle. No further promotional messages sent. Caller privacy preserved.)

teamMessage.text: [WEEKLY DISPATCH REPORT] 48 calls answered (100% triage rate), 19 emergency jobs booked ($28.4k pipeline), 7 spam calls filtered, 0 missed after-hours calls.
